name: Kaji Ichiha
source:
A 2nd year student belonging to "The Nameless Honeybees" class.

Ichiha has a friendly nature and doesn't shy away from joining in on the fun. Even so, he's a calculating young man and knows how to get by in the world. He's prone to abruptly changing his attitude to suit the situation he's in or who he's around. Ichiha loves girls, and is always surrounded by his "fans". There's no telling how many girls he left broken-hearted in his wake as the school's #1 playboy. Belonging to the theatre club, he polishes his acting skills everyday.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
